research_receipts.claim: An agent action verdict should measure efficiency beside task correctness.
research_receipts.limitations: A benchmark cannot prove access to the current environment.

research_receipts.claim: Real repository tasks provide stronger agent action evidence than synthetic intent claims.
research_receipts.limitations: Repository repair does not cover every tool trace or environment.

research_receipts.claim: Task duration and success rate affect an agent action verdict.
research_receipts.limitations: Aggregate measurements do not establish this execution blocker.

research_receipts.claim: A tool trace needs declared inputs, results, and visible errors.
research_receipts.limitations: A protocol response does not prove the desired real-world effect.

disconfirmation.question: Can structure alone prove the agent action verdict result?
disconfirmation.result: No. The agent action verdict behavior still needs direct evaluation.
disconfirmation.disposition: Keep structure and agent action verdict behavior as separate gates.
